exposure: Hypomethylation of H19 imprinting control region of the 11p15.5 locus
outcome: Co-occurrence of SRS and MRKH syndrome
cohort: A single adolescent with Silver-Russell syndrome who was diagnosed with Mayer-Rokitansky-Kuster-Hauser syndrome, and previously reported cases identified through a PubMed search.
finding: This report highlights an association between Silver-Russell syndrome and Mayer-Rokitansky-Kuster-Hauser syndrome, suggesting alternative aetiopathogenic mechanisms in cases without 11p15.5 hypomethylation or dosage abnormalities.
